custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' on book spines. In real photos, even blurry text has consistent directionality and spacing. AI often generates chaotic, swirling patterns that mimic text density but lack character structure. Also, scrutinize the right-side vertical divider for 'melting' into the horizontal shelves—a common AI failure mode in complex geometry.
